packing: Microclimate layers: light fleece and rain shell even when Ponta Delgada is warm.

itinerary.labelHtml:
Your Week on São Miguel

From Ponta Delgada to the peaks and waterfalls

Each day returns to the same apartment. Swap the mountain and coast outings when weather changes, and use the listed daily amounts for meals and activities.

days.heading: Leave Pittsburgh
days.feel: Position through Boston only with protected ticketing or a conservative overnight buffer.

facts.label: Route rule
facts.valueHtml: PIT → Boston → PDL; reject separate tickets.

days.note: The short trip only works if the long-haul is protected and reasonably timed.

days.heading: Land, unpack and walk Ponta Delgada
days.feel: Airport, apartment, groceries and an easy marina evening.
days.note: No rental-car pickup after an overnight flight.

spots.cost: Old town, marina and pineapple greenhouses are free or low-cost. Budget $17–28 per adult for a whale-watching harbor option only after checking sea conditions.
spots.climate: June in Ponta Delgada: mild, often 61–72°F, with quick showers and bright breaks. This is the deliberately car-light arrival day.
spots.saveHtml: Save Walk the Portas da Cidade, marina and Mercado da Graça, then cook in the apartment.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Use a calm-sea afternoon for a reputable whale-watching departure from the marina.
spots.restoHtml:
• Forneria São Dinis — pizza and pasta.
  • Supléxio — burgers and fries.
  • Continente Modelo — apartment and picnic fallback.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Pineapple plantation if rain arrives.
  • Carlos Machado Museum for a wet afternoon.
  • Marina sunset and an early night after the overnight flight.

days.heading: Sete Cidades when the caldera is clear
days.feel: Vista do Rei, Boca do Inferno and lakeshore picnic.

facts.label: Walking
facts.valueHtml: Short summit segment + easy Boca do Inferno default

days.note: Move this day whenever the summit forecast is clearest.

spots.cost: Viewpoints and the lakeshore are free. Kayak or bike hire is optional; verify the current family rate and wind conditions.
spots.climate: Caldera weather: cloud can erase the view even when Ponta Delgada is bright. Start early and swap days rather than waiting in fog.
spots.saveHtml: Save Drive Vista do Rei, Boca do Inferno and the village, with a supermarket picnic by the lake.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Book a guided rim walk or lake kayak only on a clear, low-wind day.
spots.restoHtml:
• Green Love — burgers, sandwiches and fries.
  • Lagoa Azul — grilled plates with simple sides.
  • Packed lunch — best weather-flex tool.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Mosteiros coast if the caldera is clouded in.
  • Ferraria viewpoints without entering the water.
  • Ponta Delgada museum day in persistent rain.

days.feel: Steam, gardens and one warm managed thermal swim.

spots.cost: Budget for Terra Nostra or Dona Beija, not both by default. Reserve timed thermal entry where required and confirm current child rules.
spots.climate: Warm water is dependable; air weather is not: thermal pools are roughly 95–104°F while June Atlantic water is much cooler. Bring dark swimwear.
spots.saveHtml: Save Choose one managed thermal complex, walk Furnas village and watch the steaming caldeiras.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Add a guided Furnas day with cozido lunch so neither adult drives the long return.
spots.restoHtml:
• A Quinta — pizza, burgers and grilled chicken.
  • Caldeiras & Vulcões — cozido plus plain sides.
  • Padaria Gloria Moniz — sandwiches and pastries.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Gorreana tea plantation in a shower.
  • Pico do Ferro viewpoint between clouds.
  • Return early for an apartment dinner.

days.heading: Ponta Delgada reset day
days.feel: Late breakfast, pineapple greenhouses and optional calm-sea whales.
days.note: This buffer absorbs jet lag and any weather-driven swap.

days.heading: Lagoa do Fogo + Caldeira Velha
days.feel: High crater views first, warm forest pool second.

facts.label: Walking
facts.valueHtml: Lagoa do Fogo 4.3 km / ~3 hr signed route; Caldeira Velha is optional

days.note: A valid reservation and an open official status are go/no-go requirements.

spots.saveHtml: Save Use short official viewpoints and reserve a standard thermal slot rather than a full guided tour.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Take a small-group Lagoa do Fogo/Caldeira Velha tour if the family wants to avoid mountain driving.
spots.restoHtml:
• Alabote — grilled food and fries in Ribeira Grande.
  • TukáTulá — burgers and simple beach plates.
  • Packed picnic — protects the clear-weather window.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Ribeira Grande old town if the crater is hidden.
  • Santa Bárbara beach viewpoint without swimming.
  • Furnas thermal day if Caldeira Velha is unavailable.

days.heading: Nordeste waterfall and tea loop
days.feel: Ribeira dos Caldeirões, Gorreana and one east-coast viewpoint.
days.note: Turn around early on PR8; this is a view day, not an endurance test.

spots.cost: Ribeira dos Caldeirões park and Gorreana are free; budget only food and fuel unless adding a guided canyon or tea experience.
spots.climate: The long green loop: the northeast is wetter than Ponta Delgada. Waterfalls look best after rain, but slippery paths require conservative footwear and pace.
spots.saveHtml: Save Drive the signed main roads to Gorreana, Ribeira dos Caldeirões and one Nordeste viewpoint, then return before dark.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Use a small-group Nordeste tour so both adults can watch the scenery and nobody manages the longest driving loop.
spots.restoHtml:
• Restaurante Tronqueira — grilled meat, fries and simple sides.
  • Gorreana café — sandwiches, cake and tea.
  • Apartment dinner — reliable after the long loop.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Ribeira Grande old town if rain becomes heavy.
  • Short Gorreana plantation walk without the full northeast loop.
  • Final Ponta Delgada shopping and thermal re-soak.

days.feel: Whales, tea, thermal re-soak or a true rest day.

days.note: Keep this day unbooked; return the rental by evening if the flight is early.

days.heading: Fly home to Pittsburgh
days.feel: Keep the Boston connection protected or generously buffered.

Let weather lead and keep meals simple

A little flexibility matters more here than squeezing in another attraction.

What June Feels Like

Warm coast, changeable peaks, refreshing water

São Miguel rewards families who dress in layers and treat the daily forecast as an invitation to choose the right side of the island.

Mild, mostly dry coast

Ponta Delgada is usually comfortable for walking and outdoor dinners in June. The peaks can still be cloudy, windy and much cooler.

Swimming is a bonus

Dona Beija and Terra Nostra offer managed water access, but the Atlantic remains refreshing and swell can change the plan.

Simple days from Ponta Delgada

Every outing returns to the same apartment, with no ferry, extra flight or hotel move. The only complicated choice is finding a good protected fare to the island.
